messages:

Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 13:15:00 -0400
Subject: RFI: Private deployment capability questionnaire for Stevenson Financial

Hi Neha,

Thanks for taking our call last week. As mentioned, Stevenson Financial is preparing a short list of vendors for a private deployment (VPC / on‑prem / air‑gapped) of an LLM inference platform. Attached is our standard RFI questionnaire that covers network topology, authentication, key management, evidence for SOC2 controls, and air‑gapped upgrade procedures.

Can you confirm you can return the completed questionnaire within five business days? We are targeting vendor short‑listing by the end of the month; the output will be reviewed by our security and procurement teams.

Attachment: Stevenson_RFP_2026_questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx, 312KB)

A few immediate clarifications we care about:
- Do upgrades require outbound internet access for the control plane?
- Can you provide a contact for SOC2 evidence delivery and redaction process?
- Is there an offline installation option for air‑gapped environments?

Look forward to your reply.

Best,
Emily Stevens
Senior IT Security Manager
Stevenson Financial

Subject: Re: RFI: Private deployment capability questionnaire for Stevenson Financial

Emily —

Thanks for sending this over and for the conversation last week. We can absolutely complete the questionnaire and will aim to return a fully annotated copy by end of day Friday (five business days).

I’ve looped in the responses team: Laura (sales lead, will coordinate the commercial and timeline items), Monica (security & compliance owner, will handle SOC2 delivery questions), and Vivek (deployments lead, will take the technical install/air‑gap answers).

Immediate, high‑level answers to the three bullets you called out:
- Control plane upgrades: For our Redwood Private offering we support both online and offline upgrade paths. Online upgrades use an authenticated control channel; offline upgrades are available for air‑gapped installs via signed artifact bundles and verified upgrade tooling — no outbound internet required during the upgrade itself.
- SOC2 evidence: Monica will be your primary contact; we provide redacted SOC2 artifacts through a secure file transfer process and can arrange a redaction checklist and NDA if needed.
- Offline installation: Yes — we provide an air‑gapped installer (tarball + signed checksums) and install playbooks.

We’ll return the completed questionnaire as a marked‑up XLSX and a short security annex PDF summarizing deployment architectures and evidence procedures.

Thanks — we’ll follow up with the completed package.

Best regards,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 08:47:00 -0400
Subject: Re: RFI: Private deployment capability questionnaire for Stevenson Financial

Emily —

Attached is our completed questionnaire and a short security annex that summarizes the evidence and procedures you asked about. Key callouts in the answers:

1) Network & control plane
- Private control plane option: Customers can choose a customer‑managed private control plane deployed into their VPC (control plane components run in customer account) or an isolated management plane hosted in a private customer VPC operated under a contractual boundary.
- Upgrades: Online upgrades use outbound TLS to Redwood’s artifact repository only if customers opt for hosted artifact updates. For air‑gapped installs we deliver signed artifact bundles (sha256) and an upgrade verification tool; the upgrade process is fully offline — the node performing the upgrade does not require internet access.

2) Authentication & key management
- KMS: Integrations available for AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, Google Cloud KMS and customer HSMs via PKCS#11. Secrets never leave customer boundary in the private control plane deployment.
- Service-to-service auth: Mutual TLS with cert rotation is supported; certificates can be provisioned via customer CA.

3) Evidence & SOC2 artifacts
- We maintain a SOC2 Type II report and a controls matrix mapping to questionnaire sections. We provide redacted SOC2 artifacts via sftp or direct transfer to your secure repository; PII and customer identifiers are redacted per our redaction checklist.
- If you require on‑site review or auditor coordination, we will support a scoped engagement (statement in the Annex).

4) Air‑gapped operations & patching
- Installer: Air‑gapped installer tarball, signed release manifest, and an offline dependency package are provided.
- Patching cadence: Security patches provided as signed hotfix bundles; emergency hotfix process is documented in the Annex.
- Rollback: All upgrades are transactional with an explicit rollback path documented per release.

5) Data handling & logging
- Audit logs: Configurable retention and delivery (S3, local syslog, or SIEM connector). Logs can be kept entirely within customer storage.
- Data residency: Model artifacts and customer data remain in customer environment for private deployments.

Attachments (sent): redwood_private_deploy_security_annex.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB); redwood_completed_rfi_Stevenson.xlsx (xlsx, 420KB)

If you prefer, Vivek and I can set a 30‑minute walkthrough with your security team tomorrow to step through any areas of interest (installation sequence, artifact verification, or SOC2 redaction).

Regards,
Monica Patel
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
